2609.35441.title: Riccati State Space Models: Non-iterative Parallelization for Nonlinear Sequence Modeling
2609.35441.paper_summary: State space models (SSMs) achieve efficient sequence processing because their affine state updates are closed under composition and can therefore be evaluated with an associative parallel scan. Nonlinear recurrent models can provide richer, state-dependent dynamics, but generally lose this compositional structure: parallel evaluation then requires iterative methods that repeatedly linearize and scan the recurrence. We ask, what state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can be designed to remain exactly composable? We answer by introducing RiccatiSSM, a nonlinear SSM, in which each state dimension follows an input-conditioned Riccati differential equation. Its quadratic state dependence makes the local Jacobian explicitly state-dependent, while its exact per-step flow under piecewise-constant inputs is a Möbius transformation. Since Möbius maps are closed under composition and compose through $2\times 2$ matrix multiplication, the complete nonlinear state trajectory can be evaluated exactly with a single associative parallel scan, without iterative linearization. We further derive a constrained parameterization that ensures bounded, contractive dynamics, and avoids poles in the fractional-linear state update. Across long-sequence classification, regression, and forecasting tasks, RiccatiSSM achieves competitive predictive performance while reducing runtime by $22{-}33\%$ compared to the nonlinear LrcSSM under matched architectures. These results demonstrate that state-dependent nonlinear dynamics can retain exact composability and be evaluated efficiently within a single parallel scan.
2609.35441.paper_summary_zh: 狀態空間模型（SSMs）能夠實現高效的序列處理，因為它們的仿射狀態更新在組合下是封閉的，因此可以通過關聯並行掃描進行評估。非線性遞歸模型可以提供更豐富的狀態依賴動態，但通常失去了這種組合結構：並行評估因此需要迭代方法，這些方法反覆線性化並掃描遞歸。我們問，什麼樣的狀態依賴非線性動態可以設計為保持完全可組合？我們的回答是引入RiccatiSSM，一種非線性SSM，其中每個狀態維度遵循一個輸入條件的Riccati微分方程。其二次狀態依賴使得局部雅可比矩陣明確依賴於狀態，而在分段常數輸入下的每步精確流動則是一個Möbius變換。由於Möbius映射在組合下是封閉的，並且通過$2\times 2$矩陣乘法進行組合，因此完整的非線性狀態軌跡可以通過單一的關聯並行掃描精確評估，而無需迭代線性化。我們進一步推導出一種約束參數化，確保有界的收縮動態，並避免分數線性狀態更新中的極點。在長序列分類、回歸和預測任務中，RiccatiSSM在匹配架構下相比於非線性LrcSSM實現了具有競爭力的預測性能，同時將運行時間減少了$22{-}33\%$。這些結果表明，狀態依賴的非線性動態可以保持精確的可組合性，並在單一的並行掃描中高效評估。
